item.title: Covalent-Bond Engineering Stabilizes Layered Oxide Cathodes for Sodium-Ion Batteries
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in tuning TM–O covalency via Cu content to optimize Na-ion cathode performance, revealing a covalency threshold: moderate covalency boosts energy density and stability by delocalizing holes and suppressing cation migration, while excessive covalency rigidifies the lattice. This establishes covalency modulation as a predictive design principle for durable layered oxide cathodes.
🏷 sodium-ion battery · layered oxide cathode · covalency tuning · Cu-O bonding · cation migration

item.title: Tailoring Covalent Organic Frameworks as Functionalized Molecular Traps to Enable Sulfur Conversion and Li + Desolvation for Durable Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a molecular trap strategy using functional-group-decoupled COFs as dual-sided separator coatings: CN-COF confines polysulfides and catalyzes sulfur conversion via C≡N sites, while COF-AO captures solvent molecules through ─NH₂/─OH hydrogen bonding to enhance Li⁺ desolvation. This synergy enables ultrastable Li plating (7000 h) and durable Li–S batteries with ultralow decay (0.024%/cycle), offering a significant design principle for practical batteries.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · covalent organic framework · polysulfide trapping · Li+ desolvation · separator coating

item.title: Preiodization Unlocks an Orbital‐Regulated Cascade Redox Chemistry for High‐Capacity Zinc‐Iodine Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a preiodization strategy that activates VS₂ catalytic electrodes via V─I orbital coupling, enabling cascade I⁰/I⁻ redox and Zn²⁺ intercalation. This exceeds conventional Zn-I₂ capacity limits while suppressing polyiodide formation, yielding 372 mAh g⁻¹ and 86% retention over 4000 cycles. It provides key insight into the orbital electronic structure–catalytic performance relationship.
🏷 zinc-iodine battery · preiodization · VS2 electrode · orbital coupling · cascade redox

💡 The novelty lies in in situ electrochemically converting a 2D MoS₂ coating on Cu current collectors into a fluorosulfided SEI with metallic Mo active sites, catalyzing NaPF₆ decomposition to form NaF.
